sources.prompt: Create a single transparent-background production pixel-art sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen genuinely distinct newly drawn poses. Four rows top-to-bottom are arrival, preparation, attack, recovery, each with four progressive full-subject poses facing RIGHT. Wide transparent gutters and outer margins separate every pose and every row. No text, letters, labels, logos, watermark, panel borders, opaque background, checkerboard, ground slab, or cropped wings/weapons. Consistent detailed crisp game sprite art matching a 256px cell after extraction. Keep the subject's bodily proportions and visual scale coherent across all sixteen poses; crouching/flight banking stays smaller, do not enlarge each pose to fill a cell. Use the attached legacy generated four-pose image only as an identifying counterexample and palette context, not as source-game proof or a strip to duplicate. Draw every one of the sixteen poses natively, with real progression and no reused transforms. Show the original 1997 Final Fantasy VII Bahamut, NOT Neo Bahamut, Bahamut ZERO, Remake/Rebirth Bahamut Arisen, or a different game's dragon. A horned muscular dark violet-gray draconic summon with a long curling tail, clawed hind legs and forearms, TWO large organic bat wings with purple membranes, a narrow fierce dragon head with backswept horns, and blue-white Megaflare mouth energy. No feathers, machinery, armor suit, extra wings, rider, or sword. Row1 four descending and wing-opening arrival poses; row2 four floating braced charge poses, blue-white energy gathers at the mouth; row3 four genuine Megaflare release poses, progressive contained mouth-beam rightwards (strong central attack in third column), always contain the full dragon, wings, tail and energy within each cell; row4 four cooling mouth/wing settling and ascent-ready recovery poses. This is an adapted original-FFVII summon presentation, not a certification of official frames.
